Patch 0.31.14 (Auth entry controls use shared classes)

  • Login and enter-world controls now use reusable classes: Auth title, auth action row, fill-width auth buttons, auth status text, and the play container button now share named start-screen classes.
  • Inline auth chrome has been reduced: Login title typography, auth button flex, status color and sizing, play container layout, and enter-world button emphasis now live in start-screen CSS.
  • The 0.31 entry-surface cleanup keeps moving downward: Start screen version, first-step guidance, login controls, and enter-world affordance now follow the same class-based styling direction.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for auth panel and play container classes and removed inline auth/enter-world chrome.

Patch 0.31.13 (Start flow panel uses shared classes)

  • First Steps panel chrome now uses reusable classes: The start-flow shell, body, title, copy, and step text now share named start-flow-panel classes.
  • Inline onboarding panel styling has been reduced: Positioning, width, margin, flex layout, body padding, title emphasis, copy color, and step typography now live in start-screen CSS.
  • The 0.31 entry-surface cleanup continues: The login screen now treats its version row and onboarding guidance as reusable styling surfaces instead of one-off inline blocks.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for start-flow panel shell/body/text classes and removed inline first-steps panel chrome.

Patch 0.31.12 (Start screen version row uses shared classes)

  • Start screen version chrome now uses reusable classes: The visible Alpha version label and login-screen Patch Notes shortcut now share named start-version-row classes.
  • Inline login version styling has been reduced: The row spacing, version typography, gold shortcut color, underline, cursor, and link offset now live in start-screen CSS.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass is now reaching the entry surface: The same class-based menu polish direction now covers support windows, Patch Notes content, and the first visible version affordance.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for start-version-row label/link classes and removed inline login version row chrome.

Patch 0.31.11 (Patch Notes header uses shared classes)

  • Patch Notes header helper text now uses reusable classes: The full commit history hint and link now keep their compact secondary styling through named patch-notes header classes.
  • Inline Patch Notes header chrome has been reduced: The remaining one-off font, color, margin, underline, and pointer styles now live in shared CSS.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass keeps tightening support windows: Patch Notes now shares shell, scroll body, entry chrome, and header metadata styling through class-based CSS.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for Patch Notes header meta/link classes and removed inline header helper styling.

Patch 0.31.10 (Help guide content uses shared classes)

  • Help screen sections now use reusable guide classes: Core Controls, First Hour Milestones, and Daily Return Loop now share help-guide section, title, separator, and highlighted key styling.
  • Inline Help content styling has been reduced: Shortcut labels, numbered guide markers, and section dividers now use class-based CSS instead of repeated inline gold and border styles.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass keeps moving inside support windows: Help now shares support-window shell/body chrome plus reusable internal guide content classes.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for Help guide title/key/separator classes and removed repeated inline Help guide chrome.

Patch 0.31.9 (Pause menu special actions use shared variants)

  • Pause menu special actions now use reusable variants: Report Bug / Feature and Unstuck / Respawn now keep their warning and danger styling through named pause-menu button classes.
  • The Escape menu has less inline chrome: The remaining one-off border and color styles in the pause action stack now live in shared CSS.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass keeps tightening primary menus: Pause now shares viewport-safe shell, action-stack layout, and special action variants through class-based styling.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for pause menu report/danger button variants and removed inline pause action styling.

Patch 0.31.8 (Report form fields use shared controls)

  • Report form inputs now use reusable control classes: The report type select and report text area now share the support-field control styling already used by Settings fields.
  • The text area has a named variant: Report text keeps resize behavior through a reusable support-field textarea class instead of one-off inline styling.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass keeps consolidating support menus: Report now shares shell, body, actions, buttons, and field chrome with the rest of the support-window layer.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for reusable Report form field classes and removed inline report select/textarea chrome.

Patch 0.31.7 (Patch Notes content uses shared entry classes)

  • Patch Notes content now uses reusable entry chrome: Release titles and bullet lists now share patch-note title and list classes instead of repeating inline heading and list styles on every entry.
  • Patch history spacing is owned by CSS: Patch note entries now get their bottom spacing from the shared patch-note-entry class instead of per-entry margin styles.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass extends inside support windows: Patch Notes now shares both its support-window shell and its repeated content styling through class-based CSS.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for patch-note entry title/list classes and removed repeated inline Patch Notes content chrome.

Patch 0.31.6 (Settings asset cache uses shared panel classes)

  • Asset cache Settings now use reusable panel classes: The cache header, status, progress meter, pack list, badges, metadata, and action row now share asset-cache CSS instead of inline layout and typography.
  • Cache action buttons now use named variants: Recommended download, refresh, update, and clear actions keep their visual intent through reusable button modifier classes instead of one-off inline color styles.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass keeps consolidating Settings: Settings now shares shell, body, footer, action-row, core field, and asset-cache panel patterns before moving on to the next client menu surface.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for asset-cache panel markup, meter styling, pack badge styling, action button variants, and removed inline cache chrome.

Patch 0.31.5 (Settings core fields use shared form classes)

  • Core Settings rows now use reusable support-field classes: Graphics quality, brightness, auto-loot, camera shake, and fullscreen controls now share field, row, label, hint, value, select, and range styling.
  • Repeated inline form styling has been reduced: The primary Settings controls no longer duplicate label colors, hint typography, row layout, or range width inline.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass keeps tightening support menus: Settings now shares shell, body, footer, action-row, and core field patterns before the asset-cache section gets its own cleanup.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for support-field markup and reusable Settings form CSS.
